array.string: export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; LOG=/tmp/wago-watchdog.log; TS=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"); if ! /usr/local/bin/docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[$TS] Docker no disponible" >> $LOG; exit 0; fi; for SVC in waha redis api; do if ! /usr/local/bin/docker compose -f /Users/govideo/Documents/WAGO/docker-compose.yml ps --status running --services 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^${SVC}$"; then echo "[$TS] Levantando $SVC..." >> $LOG; /usr/local/bin/docker compose -f /Users/govideo/Documents/WAGO/docker-compose.yml up $SVC -d >> $LOG 2>&1; fi; done; echo "[$TS] OK" >> $LOG
